Python Study Hub: learn Python for data analysis

A free, interactive course for aspiring data analysts, from your first print() to NumPy.

  • 23 chapters in plain, simple English, from your first print() to NumPy, in 8 Parts
  • A real Python runner in the browser (Python 3.12 with NumPy) under every practice task, with a Check my answer button, and a Try it button on every code example
  • Animated explainers that run code line by line, slide decks, mind maps and a revision poster for every chapter
  • A short video by a real teacher for every chapter (English, plus Telugu for 14 chapters)
  • Practice on a realistic, messy hotel bookings dataset, plus an end-to-end mini project
  • An overview page for every Part with key definitions, big comparison tables, "don't mix these up" tables and a picture cheat sheet
  • 115 quick fill-in-the-blank exercises (5 per chapter) with instant checking
  • Quizzes, a final exam, flashcards with spaced repetition, a cheat sheet, a glossary and a full Python reference
  • Works on phones, has dark mode, works offline after the first visit, no ads and no sign-up
